description: Use it when the person asks what a stay costs and has no exact days or yacht yet. Pass the place they named (in words, or a placeId a search_yachts or list_places answer gave), how many nights the stay is, the party, and the month when they named one. nights and party are required: ask the person when they have not said them. It answers, for the yachts there with room for the party, the range of each one's lowest price for a stay of that many nights starting that month, as the company states it for the whole stay (p25, median and p75, in minor units of the currency; no extras), how many yachts it is from and the cheapest one by its id, name and town. Say each figure with its nights; it is a weekly price only when the stay is 7 nights. With no month, the next months with prices and a note to ask which. An unknown place answers with suggestions; a name of more than one place lists them to choose. For yachts free on their days, call search_yachts. When the person picks a yacht, call request_quote (ask their email or phone first). Arguments: place, month, nights, party. Any other name is refused.

month.description: YYYY-MM, or the month's name ("July"). Leave out when the person has not said: the answer gives the next 3 months with prices.

nights.description: How many nights each stay is: every figure is a stay of this length. Ask the person when they have not said.

place.description: Where, in words (a region, a country or an area inside one), or a place value as an unknown_place answer lists them.

name: price_range

browsing.description: true: answered without sign-in, so fewer rows and the first pages only.

cheapest.description: The cheapest item that fits, that month.

id.description: Its BM id, to pass to get.

currency.description: ISO 4217, as BM states it; other currencies are left out, never converted.

items.description: How many items the figures are from.

month.description: The month the figures are for, YYYY-MM.

monthNote.description: Only when no month was asked: those months in words, and to ask the person which month.

months.description: Only when no month was asked: the next months with prices, each with items, range (minor units) and thin.

place.description: The place answered, by BM's name (e.g. Croatia).

placeId.description: That place's id, to pass back as placeId to search.

range.description: p25, p50 (median), p75 of each item's lowest stay of the asked nights that month, for the whole stay, minor units (e.g. cents); null when too few items.

read.description: How the figures were read, in words.

thin.description: true: few items, a rough figure.

title: Price range
